title: Among users located in California who have obtained either a “Supporter” or
question: Among users located in California who have obtained either a “Supporter” or an “Organizer” badge, identify the user with the highest reputation and return only the user’s display name (DisplayName).

prediction.sql:
SELECT u.XCL_055
FROM users AS u
INNER JOIN badges AS b ON u.XCL_052 = b.XCL_002
WHERE u.XCL_058 = 'California'
  AND b.XCL_003 IN ('Supporter', 'Organizer')
ORDER BY u.XCL_053 DESC
LIMIT 1
